capabilities: Chat with local LLMs about vault notes
Search notes with BM25 ranking and grep and cite the notes used
Create, edit, move or delete notes after an approval dialog
Read text in images with a vision model
extras: Vault tools run in an in-process MCP server with no network port; no embeddings or index database to build. The plugin shows a built-in review request pop-up after five answered questions and an hour of use, which can be dismissed or stopped permanently.
motivation: The author wanted AI chat over sensitive notes and private thoughts without sending them to someone's servers.
problem: AI chat over notes usually means sending sensitive note content to someone else's servers.

relations.evidence: It runs on the open-source Pi agent harness.

summary: Chat plugin that answers questions about your notes with local LLMs via LM Studio, searching and citing notes and editing them only after approval.
